insight.headline: OrderCreate Mutation
insight.what_changed: The orderCreate mutation now supports multiple tracking numbers for each fulfillment. A trackingNumbers field has been added to OrderCreateFulfillmentInput, allowing multiple tracking numbers to be attached to a fulfillment when importing orders. This change enables more accurate tracking and fulfillment management.
insight.developer_impact: Developers using the orderCreate mutation to import orders should update their code to utilize the new trackingNumbers field. This may involve modifying existing fulfillment workflows and updating API calls to include multiple tracking numbers. The GraphQL Admin API will need to be updated to reflect these changes, specifically the OrderCreateFulfillmentInput type. No immediate action is required, but it is recommended to update code to take advantage of the new functionality.
insight.merchant_impact: Merchants will benefit from more accurate tracking and fulfillment management, as multiple tracking numbers can now be associated with a single fulfillment.
insight.why_it_matters: This change improves the flexibility and accuracy of order fulfillment, allowing for more efficient tracking and management of shipments. It is an important update for developers working with the Shopify GraphQL Admin API, particularly those building fulfillment services apps.

recap.headline: Hydrogen updates and ShopifyQL expansion highlight the week

themes.title: Hydrogen Updates
themes.detail: Multiple Hydrogen-related packages received updates, including @shopify/cli-hydrogen, @shopify/mini-oxygen, @shopify/hydrogen, and @shopify/create-hydrogen, with improvements such as new flags, HTTP/2 support, and secure OAuth state values. The skeleton package also saw updates, recommending the Shopify AI Toolkit in newly scaffolded storefronts.

themes.title: ShopifyQL Expansion
themes.detail: Shop Campaigns performance data is now available via ShopifyQL, allowing analytics and reporting apps to query performance data on behalf of authorized merchants using the existing ShopifyQL schema.
